title: First Battle of Chattanooga
summary: The English Wikipedia article "First Battle of Chattanooga", at revision 1370618532, opens: "The First Battle of Chattanooga was a minor artillery battle in the American Civil War, fought on June 7–8, 1862." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2443807, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "minor battle of the American Civil War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
